about: The node's reporting engine (01-model-danych.md §6; zadania/zrobione/TASK-01.md). A cycle of ReportInterval counted from the write that set it, carrying a value never reported before; a change reported at once, before the reply, as the command handler runs first; Enabled = 0 on a functional endpoint refuses commands with INVALID_STATE, still answers reads and writes, and silences the cycle. On Diagnostics: the start sets the baseline without a report, TxErrorCount waits for ReportHysteresis (16), BusState is an enum and reports any change, ReportMinGap holds a report back and releases the CURRENT value, and a cyclic report is ONE round — every reported attribute of the endpoint at once, the gap counted between rounds (N3). Writes of the common settings land in the store under a<endpoint>.<id>.
